tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po don 'dus las: dbang rnams snying por bsdus pa bzhugs: 1$0000300

bka' 'dus rtsa ba'i snying tig go / ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bla ma he ru ka la 'dud:1$0000250 rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po 'dus pa las: dbang rnams snying por bsdus pa bstan: dkyil 'khor bzhengs la rdzas rnams bkod: de nyid nus pa ldan par bsgrub: slob ma dkyil 'khor la bcug nas: dbang rnams rim par bskur bar bya:1$0000300 hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang du: ye shes lha tshogs zhu ba'i chus: skal ldan rnams la dbang bskur bas: snang ba lha ru 'gyur bar shog: ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 khro bo'i gsang bum spyi bor bzhag: 1$0000300hūm̐: gsang ba'i dung chen bandha ru: bla ma he ru ka yab yum: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems: skal ldan rnams la dbang bskur bas: glo bur dri ma kun bsregs nas: phung khams skye mched ma lus pa: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs: gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin par shog: gu hya ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 gshin rje bam gyi dbang bskur ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: dngos grub chen po thob pa'i phyir: bam chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bzhugs: 'od zhu dngos grub chen por 'khyil: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog: ti raḥsiddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: dang po sgrub pa khrom byang brten: bar du srung zlog khrom gyis mdzad: tha ma dgra bgegs khrom la 'debs: bsnyen sgrub las rnams myur 'grub shog:1$0000250 dbang gi rta dbu'i dbang bskur ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: dbang chen 'dus pa'i skur bsgoms nas: rta skad bzhad pa'i dbang bskur bas: 'khor 'das snang srid dbang sdud nas: dngos grub las rnams myur 'grub shog: ha ya grī wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 yang dag mar me'i dbang bskur ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: dbyings kyi rang bzhin bandha ru: bde chen ye shes mar khus bkang:

ru lu 'bru brgyad sdong po la: ye shes dgu yi mar me spar: yang dag thugs kyi dbang thob shog: dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 yon tan bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: bhandha kha sbyor pho brang du: che mchog yab yum rol pa yi: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyis bkang: dkar dmar thig le'i ngo bo ru: sku gsung thugs su dbang bskur bas: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal thob shog: a mṛta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 phrin las phur pa'i dbang bskur ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rten mchog kī la ya: dkyil 'khor gsum du gsal byas nas: skal ldan bu la gnyis med thim: bsnyen sgrub las gsum dbang thob shog: badzra kī li kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 ma mo'i mdos gtor dbang bskur ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: mkha' 'gro bde chen dkyil 'khor gsum: sgrub rten mdos dang dbyer med pa: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung thig ler dbyer med thim: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na: srid pa'i ma mo dbang du sdus: las kyi ma mo zor gyis 'dus: phrin las 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: ḍā ki nī lo ka ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 dregs pa'i phrin las bka' gtad ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: gtor snod dur khrod gzhal yas khang: gtor ma dregs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: skal ldan slob mar gtad pa yis: bstan srung phrin las 'grub par shog: sarba duṣṭān karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 drag sngags zor gyi dbang bskur ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: thun snod e sgrom 'bar ba ru: thun rdzas dmod pa'i mtshon cha can: skal ldan rnams la gtad pa yis: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: sarba duṣṭān mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang: 1$0000300hūm̐: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob thod pa rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: byin rlabs dngos grub sprin chen gtibs:

rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas: skal ldan slob mar dbang bzhi skur: dbyer med rig rtsal thob par shog: ma hā gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas su: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud 'dus: skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: dbang bskur gzhan rnams ma thob kyang: bsnyen sgrub las la dbang bas na: yongs rdzogs dbang bskur chen po 'o:1$0000250 sa ma ya rgya rgya: 1$0000300 sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams nam mkha' mdzod kyi lho phyogs g.yu 'bar brag nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser glegs bam gyi ngos las/ phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i snying po zla gam dbang chen phug par gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
